judgement.reason: It turns anxious people from self-scrutiny about election to Christ, not those unable to believe in him.
It shows the council ruling after public argument and gives an eyewitness account as evidence.
It answers anxiety about election by pointing to Christ, a nearby case to struggling to believe.
It shows the reading method (correction only from Scripture) but does not say what a modern reader might miss.
Zwingli rests his teaching on Scripture and accepts correction only from Scripture.
It shows Scripture tested in public and the council deciding, but much of it is detail beyond the question.
It tells who shared discipline with pastors, bearing on one part of authority.
It shows who joins pastors in discipline, not how the community responded when it failed someone.
It turns a mind anxious about its standing away from self-scrutiny to Christ.
It is Zwingli's doctrine of the Mass and does not bear on how reliable any outside record is.
It describes elders joining pastors in censure but does not say how a person like the asker would be regarded.
